name: Al Majed for Oud Company
summary: Al Majed for Oud Company manufactures, retails, and distributes perfumes and oud products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Gulf countries. The company offers perfumes for men, women, unisex, kids, hair, and body; wood and oud oils; incense; gift items; homes essentials that include fresheners and saffron; and bundles. Al Majed for Oud Company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
